department: School of Molecular and Cellular Biology

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027, with all letters in; incomplete applications are not reviewed. (The page still shows the Fall 2026 date, December 1, 2025.)
deadline.quote: The application deadline for the MCB PhD program is December 1.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores, General or Subject, are not required and will not be considered if sent.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not required for admission. GRE scores submitted as part of the application will not be considered.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required and are not considered.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required for admission. GRE scores submitted as part of the application will not be considered.

toefl_min.value: MCB needs TOEFL iBT 96 overall with speaking 22, higher than the Graduate College minimum. Only TOEFL and IELTS are accepted.
toefl_min.quote: MCB requires a minimum overall score of at least 96 and a minimum speaking section score of at least a 22 on the TOEFL.

ielts_min.quote: MCB requires a minimum overall score of at least a 7.0 and a speaking section score of at least a 7.5 on the IELTS.

supervisor.value: No need to contact faculty or secure an advisor; admitted students do three five-week rotations and choose a lab in December of year one.
supervisor.quote: It is not necessary to reach out to MCB faculty during the application cycle. The MCB PhD Program does not require applicants to secure a research advisor.

funding.value: All PhD students get a stipend with full tuition and partial fee waiver; departments guarantee support with satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Departments guarantee financial support to students as long as they make satisfactory progress toward their degree.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in biological or physical sciences is required; no master's needed.
entry_route.quote: Admission to the MCB PhD program requires a bachelor's degree in biological or physical sciences.

notes: One umbrella application for Biochemistry, Cell and Developmental Biology, Microbiology, and Molecular and Integrative Physiology. Biophysics is a separate program. No fee waivers for international applicants.
name: Molecular and Cellular Biology PhD Program
